title: Parts, shop supplies and fee rows in the report read as before
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • You can also sign in as an Admin to a build without this change (for example staging, while its New Line window still shows "What Are You Doing?"), at a location {Location-B} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154722 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154722 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • {Work-order-1} has a labor line {Line-1} (for example "Replace tie rod" / "excessive play"), a received part (for example part number ZZAUTOTEST-WW-22-P, description Brake pad set), a shop supplies charge and a fee (for example ZZ Disposal fee, $10).
  • {Work-order-1} has been completed and invoiced as invoice {Invoice-A} (for example 10234), dated {Invoice-date-A} (for example 13 Oct 2026).
  • On the build without this change, work order {Work-order-2} for customer {Customer-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154722 Fleet B) has the same rows with the same values and is invoiced as {Invoice-B} (for example 20456) on the same date.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports page and click Export Reports (if it is not there, open it from Administration).
  2. Choose the Customer Invoice report.
  3. Set the date range to cover {Invoice-date-A}.
  4. Download the report.
  5. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet (for example Google Sheets: File, Import, Upload).
  6. Find the row for {Line-1} on invoice {Invoice-A} and read its ItemDescription cell.
  7. Read the ItemDescription cells of the part row, the shop supplies row and the fee row.
  8. On the build without this change, download the Customer Invoice report for the same date range.
  9. Find the rows for invoice {Invoice-B} and read the same three ItemDescription cells.
  10. Compare each of the three rows with its partner from step 7.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: none of the three rows carries the labor line's title or description, and none is joined with " - " by this change.
  • Step 10: the part, shop supplies and fee rows read exactly the same on both builds.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10132 (Story 3, What Reaches QuickBooks); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S3-N3, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.3 (What reaches QuickBooks), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-014; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N3: “A parts line, a shop supplies line and a fee or discount line are unaffected: none of them carries a title-and-description pair.”
  • SV-10132 acceptance criteria: “Given a parts line, a shop supplies line or a fee or discount line, then nothing about its description changes.”
